tools.name: sebbi_overview
tools.description: What sebbi.pro offers: every product, what it does, its page, and the price. Start here.

tools.name: sebbi_terms
tools.description: The service terms and their version. Show these to the customer in full and get a clear yes before calling sebbi_create_account.

tools.name: sebbi_create_account
tools.description: Open a sebbi.pro account for the customer and return their API key. Only call after showing sebbi_terms and the customer saying yes. Seals the agreement into the chain.

tools.name: sebbi_setup_advice
tools.description: Recommend the right sebbi.pro products and give step-by-step setup with working code or a ready prompt, for how the customer builds (Python, Node, Lovable, Zapier, a website builder...) and what they want to achieve.

tools.name: sebbi_test_decision
tools.description: Send one real decision through the live engine with the customer's key and show the verdict and the sealed block.

tools.name: sebbi_pack_reference
tools.description: How Signal Packs are written: the signals, measurements, flags, operators and verdicts. Read before writing a pack.

tools.name: sebbi_check_pack
tools.description: Check a Signal Pack with the engine's own validator without publishing it.

tools.name: sebbi_publish_pack
tools.description: Publish a Signal Pack to the open library. It is sealed into the chain, dated and credited to its author. Free.

tools.name: sebbi_list_packs
tools.description: Browse the published Signal Pack library.

tools.name: sebbi_decision_report
tools.description: The machine-proof report for one decision the customer's key sealed: the decision, who sent it, where it came from, and proof it has not changed.

tools.name: sebbi_check_human_proof
tools.description: Look up a Human Keys code (HK-XXXX-XXXX): whether a human typed the text, live, and when.

tools.name: sebbi_billing_link
tools.description: A secure Stripe link for the customer to add their card and set up the 50p per device subscription.

tools.name: sebbi_verify_chain
tools.description: Re-verify sebbi.pro's whole chain and return its height and tip. Anyone can run this.

tools.name: sebbi_gateway_setup
tools.description: Put every OpenAI or Anthropic call the customer's app makes through sebbi.pro with a one-line change: returns a private gateway base URL for their sebbi.pro key and the exact line to change for their stack. Every call is then scored, sealed, blocked if needed, and carries an AI-Decision-Receipt head

tools.name: sebbi_notarize
tools.description: Timestamp fingerprints (SHA-256, 64 hex) in Bitcoin through sebbi.pro's free notary. Hash the file or text yourself and send only the fingerprint. Returns a receipt code and link for each.

tools.name: sebbi_notary_receipt
tools.description: Where a notary receipt (NT-XXXX-XXXX) or Human Keys code (HK-XXXX-XXXX) stands: queued, sent to Bitcoin, or confirmed in a Bitcoin block - and the link to its Forever Proof.

tools.name: sebbi_forever_proof
tools.description: A Forever Proof anyone can check against Bitcoin without sebbi.pro: for a notary receipt, a Human Keys code, or any block on the sebbi.pro chain. Give code or block.

tools.name: sebbi_spend_policy
tools.description: Set the spending limits for an AI agent: the most it may pay in one go and per day, and optionally an allow-list of payees. Must be set before the agent can be approved to spend.

tools.name: sebbi_spend_request
tools.description: Ask sebbi.pro to approve a payment before an AI agent makes it. Returns a signed APPROVED or DENIED token. Only release the money if it is APPROVED and spendable. sebbi.pro never holds the money.

tools.name: sebbi_spend_verify
tools.description: Check a Spend Gate token's signature and whether it may still be spent. Anyone can call this; no key needed.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "sebbi_terms" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: The service terms and their version. Show these to the customer in full and get a clear yes before calling sebbi_create_account.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
